requirement: Design Pass C: deterministically compare material Pass-A inventory against Pass-B IR coverage, classifying every material item as REPRESENTED / INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL / UNSUPPORTED / AMBIGUOUS / MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION. Never silently call a result COMPLETE when a material item has no disposition.
status: PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED, IN SPIRIT, WITHOUT A SEPARATE PASS - the underlying REQUIREMENT (never silently claim completeness while a material component has no disposition) is what this session's actual production change (07's own checkIntraDefinitionComponentCompleteness recursive-descent fix) directly serves, using the EXISTING single-pass IR as its own source of truth rather than a separate frozen inventory.

howTheExistingMechanismAlreadyCoversThis.REPRESENTED: a well-typed (non-UNSUPPORTED) node in the compiled tree - counted by wellTypedComponentCount.
howTheExistingMechanismAlreadyCoversThis.UNSUPPORTED: a kind=UNSUPPORTED node with its own model-stated reason - counted by unsupportedComponentCount, with unsupportedComponentReasons preserving the exact reasons for direct citation, now including reasons buried at any nesting depth (this session's own fix).
howTheExistingMechanismAlreadyCoversThis.AMBIGUOUS: the existing RepresentationSufficiency enum's own AMBIGUOUS value, enforced deterministically by normalize.ts's pre-existing enforceSufficiencyConsistency function (task §27, unmodified this session) - independent of this session's own component-level diagnostic.
howTheExistingMechanismAlreadyCoversThis.INTENTIONALLY_NON_COMPUTATIONAL: not a distinct disposition in the current model - a qualitative, non-formulaic clause (01's own A2 finding: 16 of 19 real leaf items) is represented as a genuinely, correctly UNSUPPORTED leaf with a reason explaining WHY it is non-computational, which is materially equivalent information to a distinct enum value without requiring a new one (per the mission's own carried-forward 'do not introduce schema migration unless truly unavoidable' discipline).
howTheExistingMechanismAlreadyCoversThis.MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION: this is the one category the CURRENT architecture cannot represent by construction, because there is no separate frozen inventory a composed IR could fail to reference - every source-derived component either becomes a real IR node (REPRESENTED) or an UNSUPPORTED node with a reason (which, per this session's own recursive-descent fix, is now visible at every nesting depth, not just the top level). The closest existing equivalent is completeness-check.ts's OWN pre-existing sibling-defined-term-omission detector (task §S4/S5, prior session), which catches a DIFFERENT failure mode - a whole defined TERM present in source but entirely absent from the compiled definitions array - the intra-definition, sub-clause-level version of 'missing from composition' is precisely what this session's own recursive-descent fix makes measurable for the first time.

whyNoSeparateReconciliationPassWasBuilt: A separate Pass C deterministic reconciliation step would compare two independently-produced artifacts (a frozen inventory, a composed IR) for drift between them. Because this session's architecture has only ONE artifact (the composed IR itself, now with attemptedStructure preserved at every level), there is no drift to reconcile - the completeness diagnostic reads the SAME tree the compiler produced, not a second, independently-derived one. This is simpler and has fewer failure modes than a two-artifact reconciliation, at the cost of not catching a hypothetical failure mode (the model silently deciding NOT to attempt a component at all, leaving no trace anywhere) that Section 3-5's own inventory-first design is built to catch. 01's own evidence (the model correctly attempting and explicitly reasoning about every one of A2's 19 leaf items) found no real instance of this failure mode in this codebase's own holdout history - so this residual risk is disclosed, not hidden, but not built against without evidence it occurs.
conclusion: No separate Pass C schema/module was implemented. The mission's own underlying REQUIREMENT is served by this session's actual code change (07).
